title: HASP audit export, schema_version 1.0
description: Authoritative shape check is in src/checks/schema.js; this document mirrors it for non-JS verifiers.

oneOf.description: Single-key export (the common case): one embedded key, no keys[] array. Byte-shape-identical to every pre-multi-key export.

Multi-key export: the window spans a signing-key rotation. keys[] carries every signing key present; each entry names which one signed it via its own key_id. Ambiguous trust root — keys[] alongside ANY singular key field — is rejected, not just all three at once.

keys.description: Present only on a multi-key export — every signing key present in the export window. Absent on a single-key export, which carries public_key_pem/key_id/key_published_at instead.

fold_base.description: Optional. The fold state the retained chain starts from — set when a retention purge rebased the history fold at the retention boundary. Absent or null means the fold starts from GENESIS (64 zeros).

lineage_reset_at.description: Optional. ISO 8601 timestamp of a forced chain-lineage reset (a prefix was truncated outside retention maintenance). When present, everything that verifies does so only for post-reset history; pre-reset entries are absent and unverifiable. Not a shape error — the verifier surfaces it loudly. Absent or null means the lineage is intact.

tsa_anchor_chain.description: May be empty (org with no anchors yet, or a range containing none). Whether that's acceptable is the anchoring check's job, not a shape constraint.

anchored_data.description: A single row's hash (v1) or a history-fold state (v2, see algo). Not required to equal chain_head_hash — which entry(ies) it attests to is a binding question for the verifier's anchoring check.

algo.description: Absent means the legacy v1 (row-hash) anchor.

anchored_entry_id.description: The anchor's latest_entry_id. Required (non-null) when algo is sha256-fold-v2; may be null or absent for legacy v1 anchors.

caller_attribution.description: Optional. Present only on a row sealed under digest_version >= 2 that carries attribution — which agent, API key, or delegation chain performed the action. Participates in the entry digest when present.

user_agent.description: Optional. Present only on a row sealed under digest_version >= 2 with a non-null value. Participates in the entry digest when present.

key_id.description: Optional. Present on every entry only when the export is multi-key (verification.keys[] present) — names which published key signed this entry.
